description: This file implements the Moondream vision service, integrating a vision-language model for image analysis and description. It defines the MoondreamService class, with methods for device detection, model initialization, and asynchronous image processing.

classes.name: MoondreamService
classes.description: A service class for image analysis using the Moondream model, supporting hardware acceleration and providing an async method to analyze images.

methods.name: detect_device()
methods.description: Detects the optimal device (XPU, CUDA, MPS, or CPU) for running the model and returns it along with the recommended data type.

methods.name: __init__( self, *, model="vikhyatk/moondream2", revision="2025-01-09", use_cpu=False, **kwargs )
methods.description: Initializes the MoondreamService by loading the specified vision-language model with appropriate device and data type settings.

methods.name: AsyncGenerator[Frame,None] run_vision(self, frame: UserImageRawFrame)
methods.description: Asynchronously processes an image frame to generate a descriptive text using the model.
